---
title: "Papers"
title-block-banner: "#2c3e50"
freeze: true
---

Enter "true" under ★ to filter for first- and corresponding-author research papers and reviews.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| column: page

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tools)
library(reactable)

# CSV file is exported from Paperpile
df <- here::here("paperpile_references.csv") %>%
  readr::read_csv()

df <- df %>%
  filter(
    `Item type` %in%
      c("Journal Article", "Preprint Manuscript", "Review", "Commentary")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Authors,
    `Publication year`,
    Title,
    `Full journal`,
    DOI,
    `Labels filed in`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    authors = Authors,
    year = `Publication year`,
    title = Title,
    journal = `Full journal`,
    star = `Labels filed in`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    journal = tools::toTitleCase(journal),
    star = case_when(
      star == "Highlight" ~ T,
      is.na(star) ~ F
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(year))

# Shorten author field
simplify_authors <- function(x) {
  vapply(
    strsplit(x, ","),
    function(parts) {
      parts <- trimws(parts)
      parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
      if (length(parts) >= 4) {
        paste0(parts[1], " et al.")
      } else {
        paste(parts, collapse = ", ")
      }
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

df$authors_simple <- simplify_authors(df$authors)
#df %>% select(authors, authors_simple) %>% View

# Add link to title
df$title_link <- paste0(
  "<a href='https://doi.org/",
  df$DOI,
  "' target='_blank'>",
  df$title,
  "</a>"
)

# Create table
reactable::reactable(
  dplyr::select(df, star, authors_simple, year, title_link, journal),
  defaultSorted = list(year = "desc", star = "desc"),
  columns = list(
    star = reactable::colDef(
      name = "★",
      width = 50,
      align = "center",
      cell = function(value) {
        if (value) {
          "★"
        } else {
          "☆"
        }
      },
      filterable = T,
      sortable = F
    ),
    authors_simple = reactable::colDef(
      name = "Authors",
      minWidth = 100,
      maxWidth = 250
    ),
    year = reactable::colDef(
      name = "Year",
      align = "left",
      minWidth = 80,
      maxWidth = 130
    ),
    title_link = reactable::colDef(
      name = "Title",
      html = TRUE,
      minWidth = 300,
      maxWidth = 600
    ),
    journal = reactable::colDef(
      name = "Journal",
      minWidth = 150,
      maxWidth = 250
    )
  ),
  sortable = T,
  filterable = T,
  searchable = T,
  showPageSizeOptions = T,
  pageSizeOptions = c(20, 50, 100),
  defaultPageSize = 20
)
```
